title: College of Education and Human Sciences bachelor rules
notes: Selected graduation requirements common to the college's bachelor programs. Programs can be stricter; Exercise Science sets its own admission GPA and grade rules on its program page.

rules.label: Degree credits
rules.statement: Complete at least 120 credits. No more than 5 credits earned in workshops count toward a bachelor's degree.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Upper-division coursework
rules.statement: Complete at least 40 credits in courses numbered 300 or above. This is a subset of degree credits.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

source_refs.anchor: 40 credit hours in courses numbered 300 or above

rules.label: Degree GPA
rules.statement: Maintain at least a 2.00 GPA on the 120 credits counted for graduation and at least 2.00 on all UNM work.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

source_refs.anchor: 2.00 or higher on the 120 credit hours

rules.label: Composition II
rules.statement: Complete ENGL 1120 with a C or better, or an authorized proficiency score, before graduation.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

source_refs.anchor: Completion of English 1120 with a grade
